verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA wanjagala
N'ompa-Omwana wo Yesu
Abe mukwano gwange
Annyambe mu bizibu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu tolekangayo
-Okuba mukwano gwange;
Bulijjo beera nange
Era n'okunnumggamya.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naakwagala ntya Yesu?
Nze naakutonera ki?
Siraba kye mba nkuwa
Anti byonna bintu byo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Naye kye nnina kimu
Nkuwadde-omwoyo gwange;
Naakugobereranga,
Ondagirire-ekkubo.
